title: Verify prerequisites and select required assets
steps: Check threenative-assets MCP through call.mjs. Copy starfighter.glb into assets/. Download one CC0 Poly Haven ground set (albedo, normal, roughness) and four CC0 one-shots (laser, explosion, hit, lock) with asset_search_sources → source search/list-files → asset_download_file. Copy ../caravel/tools/capture-lock.sh.
check: Files exist; CREDITS.md has one row per file with source URL and the licence the tool returned.

title: Strip the template and boot the ship
steps: Delete Player, arena, touch controls and template playtests. New input map and GameState. Play loads starfighter.glb, normalises it to 4 m, and shows it under the kit sky.
check: pnpm check && pnpm build:web pass; a capture shows the ship nose pointing away from the camera. Commit and push.

title: Rail course and path coordinate
steps: CatmullRomCurve3 course about 4.5 km; coordinate += speed·dt; frame (position, tangent, up) at the coordinate; lean limit per rails-path-progress.
check: Debug `distance` grows by cruise speed × time (± 5%) in a 5 s wait scenario.

title: Ship flight model
steps: Stick shaping, bank, barrel roll, boost/brake gauge, corridor clamp with warning, per the References table. Debug: offset, speed, gauge, latched, bank, rollAngle, rolls, edgeWarning.

title: Rail chase camera
steps: Eye 8 m behind, ship offset × 0.78, 0.3 roll share, boost pull-back and brake pull-in, CameraShake offset composed last.
check: Captures at rest, hard right, and boosting show the ship framed in the lower-middle third and never clipped.

title: Laser bolts
steps: Pooled bolts; fresh press fires at once, hold repeats every 4 updates; bolt speed and life per laser-fire. Expose hit spheres for the hit pass.
check: Debug `shotsFired` rises by 7–8 per second of held fire in a scenario.

title: Enemies and wave timeline
steps: Fighters on PathFollow3D fly-in curves that fire orange shots; wall turrets; rock obstacles and arches as hit volumes; heal rings; timeline keyed by path coordinate via Scheduler/ctx.
check: AC-4 laser playtest passes after integration (task 12).

title: Charge, lock-on and homing shot
steps: Charge counter, search probes in a 6 m half box, homing shot with ramping turn rate, 6 m explosion radius.
check: AC-5 lock-on playtest passes after integration.

title: Shield, damage and roll deflect
steps: Shield pool and drain, invulnerable window, knockback, CameraShake trigger; enemy shots bounce off a rolling ship.
check: AC-6 damage playtest passes after integration.

title: Ember Rift stage
steps: Textured ground strip along the course, instanced spires, canyon walls, stone arches; enemy, turret, ring and boss meshes; scenery marked static.
check: Captures in sections A, B and C read as a desert planet canyon; play budget ≤ 128 draws and ≤ 80k triangles.

title: In-scene HUD
steps: Camera-attached shield bar, boost gauge, segment-digit hit counter, two reticles, lock box, result banner.
check: Capture shows all HUD parts legible at 1280×720; HUD values follow state in a scenario.

title: Integrate combat and look lanes
steps: Wire Weapons, Enemies, stage, HUD and the hit pass into the loop order; resolve interface mismatches; review each lane's diff.
check: AC-1 to AC-6 playtests pass together on one build. Commit and push.

title: Boss, result states and autopilot hook
steps: Carrier with three weak-point turrets and a core; clear/down phases with banner; Enter restarts; ?autopilot=1 aims at the nearest target for the proof only.

title: Final gates, captures and visual judge
steps: Run AC-8; capture gameplay frames; run the reference-image judge if João supplied a target, else record it as unverified; tick ACs with evidence.
check: AC-8 passes; PRD boxes carry real evidence. Commit and push.
